services.desc: Purchase the perfect gift: a day on Lake Wylie on one of Lake Wylie Boat Rental's luxurious pontoon boats that hold up to 10 adults. You can choose the amount you want to add to the gift card so you can buy just a portion of a rental cost, or put enough on the gift card to cover the entire rental. When you book: you will select amount you want to put on the Gift Card. You will then get emailed a Gift Card Code #. You will provide that code # as the gift to whoever you are giving the Gift Card to. They will enter that code when they make a reservation on our website and it will subtract the amount you put on the card
